versions.name: RXV2-0.9.379-json-fix
versions.notes: Fixes truncated spool-up status JSON (buffer was one size too small once the live diagnosis window was added) - the card could fail to load its settings on 0.9.377/378.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.378-torque-curve
versions.notes: Spool-up tail stab now follows real physics (Malcolm's observation): largest at the moment power returns - main-blade mass accelerating against a still-slow tail rotor - then dying away tangentially as the head reaches stable speed and tail authority builds.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.377-spool-debug
versions.notes: Spool-up tuned for LDRC's true 500-2500 channel range (times and tail clamp were sized for 1000-2000) plus a live diagnosis window in the API.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.376-motor-inv
versions.notes: Spool-up realism: added the 'High = motor OFF' switch for inverted motor channels (like Malcolm's ch6, where maximum means motor off). The governor ramp now works in power terms whichever way round your channel runs.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.375-motor-ch
versions.notes: HOTFIX for spool-up realism: it was slowing the throttle STICK channel, which on a helicopter is the COLLECTIVE - enabling it froze collective control. The spool now acts only on a dedicated Motor/governor channel you choose on the card (0 = off until set). Tip: open View channels and flip in/out of your autorotation bank - the bar that jumps is your motor channel.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.374-spool-next
versions.notes: Realistic spool-up moved to its proper home: the neXt controls & views page (RealFlight simulates its own governor, so the card only shows for neXt). Same feature as 0.9.373.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.373-spool-up
versions.notes: NEW for simulator pilots: Realistic spool-up (on the Sim controls page). When the motor comes back after an autorotation (or any throttle-hold), the head speed builds gradually like a real governor - adjustable 1-60 seconds - with an adjustable stab of tail while it accelerates, instead of the sim snapping instantly to full speed. Cutting the throttle stays instant, so entering autos is unchanged. Off by default; live-adjustable, no reboot.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.372-sim-failsafe
versions.notes: Simulator mode now obeys your saved failsafe positions: when the transmitter goes quiet, the sim's controls move to the posture you saved (Save failsafe on the View-channels page) instead of freezing at the last stick positions. Saving always worked - the sim just never applied it.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.371-genmoji-tooth
versions.notes: The Bluetooth badge is now Malcolm's own Genmoji: a glossy blue tooth with signal waves on the enamel, drawn on his iPhone. Still tap-to-disconnect.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.370-blue-tooth
versions.notes: The Bluetooth badge is now a literal blue TOOTH (Malcolm's pun, irresistible) - a little molar on the blue dot, still the tap-to-disconnect button.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.369-badge-dot
versions.notes: The Bluetooth/WiFi pill shrinks to a small dot - it was covering page content, and by now everyone knows how they're connected. In the app the dot is still the disconnect button: tap it, confirm.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.368-keyboard-exact
versions.notes: Save bar now clears the keyboard exactly: the keyboard swallows the home-indicator safe area but the bar's padding still reserved it, leaving the buttons half-hidden - reclaimed while raised.
